## Verification

List exact commands and results.

- [ ] Tests and repository gates pass (for the compiler: `cargo build --all-targets` with no warning, and `cargo test`)
- [ ] Documentation is current: README, `docs/`, and `CHANGELOG.md` when users see the change
- [ ] `STATUS.md` reflects any requirement that changed state, and a language change has its decision in `spec`
- [ ] No third-party dependency was added, or a recorded decision explains why
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`), as the contribution guide asks
- [ ] Completion evidence includes the final commit SHA
